acceptedSample.stratification: one automated PASS from each clinical family, prioritising replicate 5

items.note: NIV is supported for cardiogenic pulmonary oedema with severe dyspnoea and acidaemia despite initial medical treatment.
NICE NG196 recommendation 1.8.8 supports heparin at initial presentation in new-onset AF without therapeutic anticoagulation when not contraindicated.
Pregnancy of unknown location is correctly managed with repeat hCG near 48 hours and symptom-led follow-up; a single hCG must not determine location.
Current BSPED DKA guidance supports 10 mL/kg 0.9% saline over 30 minutes for a non-shocked child requiring IV fluids.
NICE NG12 2026 threshold for age 60-69 is CA125 >=24 IU/mL; 26 IU/mL with persistent suggestive symptoms warrants urgent direct-access ultrasound.
NICE NG253 uses NEWS2 together with clinical judgement in non-pregnant adults in acute hospital settings.
Generator stated a named score despite deterministic policy requiring raw independently reproducible components.
Concrete competing risk factors were sufficient; adding a precomputed CHA2DS2-VASc value created an avoidable deterministic failure.
Packet required a risk category without carrying exact NEWS2 category rules and 250 mL reassessed bolus details, leading to unsupported distinctions and avoidable score assertions.
Low-risk category 0-1 was paired with an exact low-risk score 0 option, creating parent/subset overlap.
Two options both started oxygen and differed only by target saturation, which the evidence packet does not support as the tested distinction.
HRT-related bleeding context was insufficient to safely distinguish suspected-cancer referral from alternative pathways.

highestLeverageDefect: Evidence-packet/prompt mismatch around named clinical scores and numerical risk categories: packets sometimes asked for a stated score/risk category while the safety layer correctly rejects precomputed named scores. This disproportionately affected anticoagulation and sepsis and also amplified reviewer uncertainty.

fixApplied.scope: temporary eval workflow only; no production merge or deployment
changes: Require raw CHA2DS2-VASc component history rather than a precomputed score for long-term AF anticoagulation items.
Require concrete thrombotic and bleeding risk factors rather than named precomputed scores for ACS-plus-anticoagulation items.
Carry exact NICE NG253 NEWS2 risk-category rules, 250 mL reassessed fluid-bolus strategy and hypercapnia oxygen target into the sepsis evidence boundary; require raw NEWS2 observations.
Require all five raw CURB-65 components and explicitly forbid category-plus-subset answer overlap.
Preserve all existing safety, ambiguity, source-support, numerical, fallback-template and single-best-answer gates.
